reason: The README identifies dsh-mobile primarily as a mobile UI adaptation that enables a mobile version of the web interface through the /m path, with an associated APK for dsh connectivity.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面提供简易移动端适配，并通过 /m 路径访问移动版界面。
summaries.en: Provides a simple mobile adaptation for the dsh web interface, accessible through the /m URL path.

capabilities: Adapts the web interface for mobile access through a /m URL path
Includes an APK described as connecting to dsh instances and supporting unfinished local deployment
